future_simple.overview: El Futuro Simple expresa una acción que se realizará en algún momento del futuro. Se forma con el infinitivo completo más terminaciones (no se quita ninguna letra del infinitivo, a diferencia de otros tiempos).

construction.rule: INFINITIVO + terminaciones (é, ás, á, emos, éis, án)
construction.note: Same endings for -AR, -ER, -IR verbs; unlike other tenses, the full infinitive is preserved

ir_a_infinitivo.name: Futuro Inmediato (Immediate Future)
ir_a_infinitivo.usage: More common in spoken Spanish; expresses near/planned future

examples.english: We are going to travel to Spain.

uses.name: Future Actions
uses.description: Expressing what will happen at a future point

examples.spanish: Yo iré a las Islas Galápagos.
examples.english: I will go to the Galápagos Islands.
In 3 years, I will have 2 children.

examples.spanish: Hablaré perfecto el español más fluido.
examples.english: I will speak Spanish more fluently, perfectly.

uses.name: Probability or Conjecture about the Present
uses.description: Expressing a guess or probability about something happening right now

examples.english: I wonder where Juan is. (Where could Juan be?)
examples.explanation: Future tense used to express uncertainty about the present

examples.spanish: Serán las tres de la tarde.
examples.english: It's probably three in the afternoon.

uses.name: Promises or Commitments
uses.description: Making a promise or firm commitment about future action

examples.english: I promise you I will come tomorrow.

future_perfect.overview: El Futuro Perfecto expresa una acción que habrá terminado antes de otra acción o momento futuro específico.

uses.name: Action Completed Before a Future Point
uses.description: An action that will be finished by a specific time in the future

examples.spanish: Para las 5, habré terminado el trabajo.
examples.english: By 5 o'clock, I will have finished the work.
When you arrive, I will have already had dinner.

uses.name: Probability about the Past
uses.description: Speculation about something that may have happened

examples.spanish: Habrá llegado tarde por el tráfico.
examples.english: He probably arrived late because of traffic.
